title: Special Topics in Advanced Performing Arts; Puppet Design and Performance
description: Students must pay a $25 course fee. Students will learn a variety of puppetry styles and building techniques with the goal of creating original performance pieces. We'll explore shadow puppetry, glove puppets, rod puppets, patterning from 3-D objects, automata, and more! Students will be expected to regularly create new, short-form puppetry pieces to share with the class.
